Q: Diving into Embedded Linux A:

Thank you for your time answering my question. What about the programming side? Is it okey to implement pthread library when I want to create a user space application?

Q: ChainedAssignmentError when adding a conditional to a pandas dataframe A:

This seems to be an updated (and much more informative!) version of the old SettingWithCopyWarning, preparing for pandas 3.0. For in-depth discussion see this answer.

The warning message is very clear in your case: change to a single assignment with

df.loc[df.loc[:,"one"] == "e", "Match"] = 1

Q: some problems we meet in LLMs A:

Sometimes Pip seems to install the wrong version of FlashAttention by default. Go to https://flashattn.dev/#finder, enter your system info, and it will give you a pip command you can use to install what should be the correct version.

Q: How to persist array data inside UDT objects between bars? A:

I guess this has been solved by now, but it's possible to put varip before array<TDetail> details = na. I assume it was not possible back when the post was written.

Q: Why is Pypy's deque so slow? A:

The slow part is inc1 in primes and inc2 in primes. I'll look at why PyPy is so slow (thanks for the performance bug report, basically).
